execution_truth: One machine cognition applied the 3D Game Asset Specialist body to one real AXM asset. This is not evidence of an independent specialist intelligence or general professional competence.

runtime_attempts.basis: Profession Fabric's repository-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN received Repository not found while attempting to fetch the separate private Wreckline repository at the pinned commit. The Godot/import steps were therefore skipped.

supersedes_access_block_for: bounded proxy attachment diagnosis and repair

gates.basis: Pinned repository, PR, exact candidate path and SHA are retained through the target-side proof run.

Retained Wreckline receipts cover generated geometry, UV/tangent state, materials/textures, LODs, separate collision, hardpoints, module contracts and semantic bindings. Runtime evidence later exposed a semantic hardpoint transform contradiction, so structural preparation is not promoted to complete acceptance.
The exact SHA-locked LOD0 GLB parsed and instantiated in Godot 4.7.2 with 47,870 vertices, 64,074 indices, 96 mesh instances and non-empty bounds. This is proof-host evidence only.
AssemblyMotion was discovered and four live engine-time samples each changed 128 node transforms. This does not establish final motion quality or penetration acceptance.

The imported semantic roof node was about 1.898 m from the explicit roof-medium hardpoint contract position, exceeding the 0.10 m tolerance; a fixed-pose proxy mounted to that node produced zero visual delta.

Using the explicit roof-medium contract position after measuring the semantic-node mismatch produced 2,576 changed pixels out of 135,000 sampled (~1.908%) and a successful attach/render/detach proxy cycle. The semantic-node defect remains.
Only an explicitly labeled contract-sized proxy was used; final module asset geometry was not imported or swapped.

Retained Godot captures render the vehicle predominantly light gray/white instead of preserving the intended darker weathered steel/orange/cyan direction. Import success is not material/shader acceptance.
A chase-like proof-host frame exists, but representative Wreckline road/chase context, LOD transitions and gameplay-camera acceptance remain untested.
Godot was a bounded proof host and was not declared to be Wreckline's final/native runtime.
No final target hardware/performance budget was declared for certification.

positive_profession_evidence: The profession preserves exact candidate identity instead of treating a later regeneration as equivalent evidence.
The profession separates structural, visual, runtime, animation, modularity and performance surfaces instead of collapsing them into one game-ready label.
The profession correctly classified the earlier private-source checkout failure as an access block rather than an asset or engine failure.
The profession reached a real proof host from the target-side repo and observed the exact candidate rather than weakening the identity requirement.
The profession tightened its own module-swap evidence after noticing that different animation times could confound a visual comparison.
The tightened test failed, exposed a 1.898 m semantic-node versus hardpoint-contract mismatch, and retained that failure.
A bounded contract-position proxy repair was demonstrated without rewriting the original defect away.
The profession preserved material fidelity as NOT_ACCEPTED despite a clean engine import.
missing_evidence_for_asset: Actual module-asset geometry import and live swap through the intended Wreckline runtime path.
Repair and re-verification of the semantic hardpoint-node transform contract.
Representative Wreckline road/chase-camera observation including LOD transition behavior.
Final/native runtime acceptance once Wreckline declares that target.
Relevant target performance measurement if a performance claim is requested.
missing_evidence_for_profession_promotio: Representative successful and failure/repair tasks across more than one asset class.
Evidence that the package works across more than one executor/intelligence without transferring stale acceptance.
Additional target/runtime diversity sufficient to show the method is not overfit to one modular vehicle and one proof host.
Observed handling of other game-asset failure families such as tangent/bake seams, LOD perceptual failure, collision mismatch, provenance blocks and deformation needs.

next_evidence_packet.priority: Repair the semantic hardpoint transform or import contract, then exercise an actual module asset rather than another proxy. Preserve the current failure receipt as the before-state.

truth_boundary: This live job now contains real proof-host runtime evidence and a retained failure/repair cycle on one substantial modular vehicle. It proves exact-candidate Godot import, live AssemblyMotion transform activity, a material semantic-socket transform contradiction, and a bounded contract-position proxy repair. It does not prove final Wreckline runtime acceptance, final module geometry, material fidelity, representative game context, target performance, broad competence, cross-intelligence validation or permission to call the asset or profession game-ready. The profession remains EXPERIMENTAL.
